what: Several photo cards overlap, each offset to the right by 5.37% of the panel width, with only the front card fully open and the rest showing just a vertical strip (4.52%) at the right edge. 3 seconds after opening, the front card folds away to the left from its right edge over 1.3s, at 4 seconds the next card unfolds from its strip over .9s, and every 5 seconds all cards slide one slot to the left over .9s cubic-bezier(.43,.05,.17,1), with the folded card going to the back strip. The front card’s caption tag appears 1s late, over 1s

options.close: When the front begins to fold (seconds, after opening), default 3
options.open: Time for the next section to unfold ahead (s), default 4
options.hold: Seconds until the folded state is released, default 3
options.[data-fx-part=card]: Cards — direct children of the element, two or more. Uses the board height as is (give the board a height)
options.[data-fx-part=face]: Face cropped inside the card (link holding the photo and title)
options.[data-fx-part=meta]: Note shown only on the front sheet (tag etc., optional)
options.--fx-card-w · --fx-step · --fx-strip · -: Card width · one cell · band width · band corner · opened corner (default 67.8cqw · 5.367cqw · 4.52cqw · .42cqw · 6px)
options.fx:slide: Each time you advance { index: original order of the front card }
